content: The resulting algorithm is summarized in Algorithm FIGREF11. Figure FIGREF11 illustrates the computation flow. Learning the manipulation parameters effectively uses a held-out validation set. We show in our experiments that a very small set of validation examples (e.g., 2 labels per class) is enough to significantly improve the model performance in low data regime.
